cases.input: Project active decision and status knowledge artifacts from one approved scope into a deterministic view sorted by updated time, preserving IDs and source references.
requiredBehaviors: apply lifecycle filtering before content filters
produce a deterministic projection with stable artifact IDs and source references
derive fields only from existing values
forbiddenBehaviors: create new domain claims while computing derived fields
skillAnchors: Wende Lifecycle-Filter vor inhaltlichen Filtern an

cases.input: Create a view where two active artifacts in the same scope carry an unresolved conflict, while an expired artifact would otherwise satisfy the requested filter.
requiredBehaviors: exclude the expired artifact under the default lifecycle policy
preserve visibility of the unresolved active conflict
keep drill-down to both conflicting source artifact IDs
forbiddenBehaviors: filter away conflict context so the view appears uniquely true
silently include expired state without an explicit caller request
skillAnchors: Offene Konflikte dürfen nicht durch Filterung als scheinbar eindeutige Wahrheit präsentiert werden

cases.input: A draft view joins artifacts from a second private scope not requested by the caller, changes a source item to mark it reviewed, and resolves a conflict by keeping the newest timestamp.
forbiddenBehaviors: silently join scopes the caller did not authorize
